name: inbox-triage
description: Job-search inbox triage agent. promptfoo evals for node and end-to-end graphs.

scripts.generate:synthetic: python evals/datasets/generate.py evals/datasets/synthetic.jsonl && python evals/datasets/to_promptfoo.py evals/datasets/synthetic.jsonl evals/datasets/synthetic.promptfoo.jsonl
scripts.eval:classify: npm run generate:synthetic && promptfoo eval -c evals/promptfooconfig/classify.yaml -o evals/results/classify.json && python -m evals.calibrate evals/results/classify.json
